ios.desc:
Never trust just one AI. Ask the world's best 5 AI models the same question. And see where they agree, where they disagree, and why it matters.

Council AI consults OpenAI ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, Perplexity Sonar, and xAI Grok models simultaneously. When they all agree, you know you can trust the answer. When they don't, you've just found your blind spot.

Three ways Council AI changes how you think:

· Consensus in seconds.  Ask any question. 5 models answer at once. Council AI shows their agreement so you instantly see what's reliable and what needs a closer look. No more wondering if one AI got it wrong.
· Built-in bias detection.  Forward any article, claim, or news story. Council AI analyzes it through multiple lenses — surfacing hidden biases, logical gaps, and unsupported claims that a single AI would miss. You'd be surprised what slips past even the top newspapers.
· Structured AI debates.  Can't decide what to believe? The Debater council argues both sides, delivers rebuttals, and summarizes — so you hear the strongest case for and against before you decide.

Pre-built councils for every angle:

Council AI comes with themed councils ready to go — Politics (Democrat, Republican, Libertarian), Pessimist/Optimist/Realist, Time/Money/Stress problem-solving, Parenting styles, and more. Or build your own custom council in seconds.

Also includes:

· Discover: curated question collections across science, history, culture, and politics — just tap and learn
· Bored mode: fun, thought-provoking questions answered by your favorite council
· Surprise me: get answers as poems, haikus, Shakespearean monologues, and other unexpected formats

Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.

Try Council AI with select models at no cost. Go Pro to unlock the world's best advanced models, unlimited questions, and every council.
Perfect for anyone who refuses to take one AI's word for it.
Made in California with love and sunshine.

In-app subscriptions

If you decide to subscribe to Council AI Pro, it will be applied to your iTunes account upon confirmation. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime by visiting the ‘Manage Subscription’ section of your account.

quotes.text:
Hi everyone,

I built this app to let users make better decisions with the wisdom of the AI crowd. The app lets you see answers from five of the best AI companies, summarizes their answers for you, and provides a summary table. This process allows you to easily spot hallucinations in certain AI models. And it lets you make better decisions. Demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/qu8FTyaLc9k

There is a Debater that can debate any topic. Demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JZzebg9gNt4

Then the app has a list of interesting questions to get you started with (think Quora). Demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/eJlbhXwZkTQ

There is also a social network where users can post questions and follow each other (think Twitter). Demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/rtTdWHrBUPA

In addition to this, it has several interesting councils (groups of AI assistants) that give you perspectives from "across the aisle". For example there is a "Politics" council that has a Democrat, Libertarian, and Republican. This way you can hear opinions from across the whole political spectrum. Or the "Parenting" council has a Permissive, Authoritative, and Authoritarian parent. This way you can see parenting advice from the whole parenting spectrum. Demo: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/waxX-M-qIVE

Please give it a try and let me know what you think. I'd greatly appreciate your honest feedback!  So sorry for the Android users, but the app is currently available only on iOS.

Thanks,
Alin Jula
